properties.value: Core TRON account crypto: every account key, transaction signature and witness signature is ECDSA on secp256k1 via this bundled bitcoinj-derived ECKey/JCE engine (params at ECKey.java:80-87, sign/verify at :937-940). Changeable only via a network-wide protocol upgrade — not unilaterally by this repo.
